title: Bob walks a tactical map of the repo

outcome: The tactical map places Bob's soldier by step count on seven fixed checkpoints, and the soldier jumps between them without walking.
The tactical map's places are the repo folders Bob has touched, with the drop zone standing for shell commands.
forbid: no engine, contracts or server change — the page derives places from the hook and mcp events it already receives (invariants 4 and 6)
page modules stay flat kebab-case files in packages/page/src — the server serves only /[a-z-]+.js

outcome: Bob's soldier walks along the map paths to the place of the file his latest tool call read, searched or edited.
forbid: the map is not rebuilt by innerHTML on each event — it stays mounted and animates per frame

outcome: An unanswered card stands as an enemy at the place where Bob was when the card arrived.
Bob's health reads the same on every screen and drops only when the developer corrects an assumption.
Every page TypeScript file is at most about 200 lines.
The page ships no Konami names or sprites; its soldier and map art are original pixel art.

disposition: Shipped: the panel's tactical map is built from the repo folders Bob touches, and his soldier walks there on each read/search/edit/command; cards stand as bug-bots where they arose; one health value; app.ts split into 10 modules; original pixel art. Multi-agent (engine sessions per session_id) left for a separate goal.
